Madhya Pradesh Government to Launch Digital Content Creator Awards

The Madhya Pradesh government, led by Chief Minister Mohan Yadav, has announced the institution of a 'Digital Content Creator Award'. This award aims to honor digital creators who are bringing about change. The announcement was made in Indore.
